Welcom to AIMI LAB!

Yixing Huang (黄益星)

Huang Yixing is currently an Assistant Professor and Full Research Professor at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center. He received his Bachelor’s degree from Peking University in 2013, and his Master’s and Doctoral degrees from Friedrich-Alexander-University Erlangen-Nuremberg in Germany in 2016 and 2020, respectively. His research primarily focuses on cone-beam CT reconstruction and image analysis, as well as medical image analysis in tumor radiotherapy, including limited-angle reconstruction, field-of-view extension, MRI brain metastasis detection and segmentation, large language model-assisted decision-making, and survival prediction for cancer patients. To date, he has published over 50 academic papers and holds 3 patents, with 30 journal and conference papers as first author or corresponding author, including top medical imaging journals TMI and MedIA, top conference MICCAI, and the Red Journal and Green Journal of radiation oncology. He leads the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas), the National Natural Science Foundation of China General Program, the Capital Health Development Research Special Youth Key Research Project, and the Beijing Natural Science Foundation Joint Fund Cultivation Project.

ResearchGate：https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Yixing-Huang-2

Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.de/citations?user=c-kuqDwAAAAJ&hl=en

黄益星，现任北京大学医学部医学技术研究院助理教授/研究员，博士生导师，2024年海外优秀青年基金获得者。2013年获北京大学学士学位，2016年和2020年分别获德国埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学硕士和博士学位。主要从事锥形束CT重建和影像分析以及肿瘤放疗中的医学影像分析，包括有限角度重建、视野扩增、MRI脑转移瘤检测分割、大语言模型决策辅助、肿瘤病人生存率预测等。目前共发表50余篇学术论文和专利3项，其中以一作和通讯发表期刊会议30篇，包括医学影像顶刊TMI和MedIA、顶会MICCAI、肿瘤放疗红皮和绿皮期刊。主持国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目（海外）、国家自然科学基金面上项目、首都卫生发展科研专项青年重点攻关项目、北京市自然科学基金联合基金培育项目。

Biography

Ao Wang is a Ph.D. student in Medical Technology at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, and a member of the AIMI Lab. Before joining Peking University, he received his B.Eng. degree from North China University of Water Resources and Electric Power and his M.Eng. degree from Chongqing University.

Haijun Yu (余海军)

Haijun Yu is a Boya Postdoctoral Fellow at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, with his collaborating supervisor being Asst. Prof. Yixing Huang. He obtained his doctoral degree from Chongqing University in September 2024. He conducted research as a joint-training doctoral student at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Germany in 2023 under the sponsorship of the China Scholarship Council (CSC). His main research areas include linear CT technology and systems, intelligent CT image reconstruction and analysis. He has published 35 academic papers with 13 as first/corresponding author in SCI journals such as Applied Mathematical Modelling, IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement, IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences, Signal Processing, Optics Express.

祝老师教师节快乐！愿课题组全体成员科研硕果累累，生活顺遂如意！

 

Happy Teachers’ Day! Wishing everyone in our research group success in research and happiness in life!

我组论文获《Physics in Medicine & Biology》接收！

近日，Xihao Wu、Jiacheng Liu、Haijun Yu、Andreas Maier 和 Yixing Huang 合作完成的论文《Self-Cascade Latent Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field-of-View Extension》获《Physics in Medicine & Biology》接收。该研究提出自级联潜空间薛定谔桥（SCL-SB），结合共享权重的两轮自级联机制与频率感知残差机制，用于恢复截断 CT 中缺失的外周解剖结构，并兼顾解剖细节恢复与推理效率。热烈祝贺各位作者！
 

Our Paper Receives Provisional Acceptance from Physics in Medicine & Biology!

The manuscript “Self-Cascade Latent Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field-of-View Extension,” authored by Xihao Wu, Jiacheng Liu, Haijun Yu, Andreas Maier, and Yixing Huang, has been accepted by Physics in Medicine & Biology. The study introduces a self-cascade latent Schrödinger bridge (SCL-SB) that combines a two-round shared-weight cascade with a frequency-aware residual mechanism to recover missing peripheral anatomy in truncated CT images while maintaining efficient inference. Congratulations to all the authors!

欢迎博士新生钟祚栋加入我们课题组！

我们很高兴地宣布，钟祚栋同学于2026年9月正式加入我们的课题组，攻读博士学位。钟祚栋本科毕业于北京科技大学自动化学院，他的研究方向主要包括医学长视频理解与高效多模态大模型架构。期待他为课题组带来新的探索与贡献，并祝愿他在博士阶段取得丰硕成果！
 

Welcome PhD Student Zuodong Zhong to Our Team!

We are delighted to announce that Zuodong Zhong officially joined our group as a PhD student in September 2026. He received his bachelor’s degree from the School of Automation at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. His research interests include long-form medical video understanding and efficient architectures for multimodal large models. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!
欢迎硕士新生唐佳晨加入我们课题组！

我们很高兴地宣布，唐佳晨于2026年9月1日正式加入本课题组，成为一名硕士研究生。她本科毕业于北京理工大学计算机学院。本科期间，她以共同一作身份发表了一篇可解释性医学影像分析论文，该论文被医学图像领域顶会MICCAI 2025接收并荣获会议奖项。她目前的研究方向为量子计算结合人工智能的医学影像应用，一个有潜力的新兴交叉学科前沿方向。我们期待她的创新性研究，并祝愿她在研究生阶段收获丰硕、前程似锦！

Welcome Master Student Jiachen Tang to Our Team!

We are pleased to welcome Tang Jiachen, who has officially joined our group as a master’s student on September 1st, 2026. She completed her bachelor’s degree at School of Computer Science, Beijing Institute of Technology. During her undergraduate studies, she co-authored a first-author paper on explainable medical image analysis, which was accepted to MICCAI 2025, a top-tier conference in medical imaging, and published. Her current research will focus on the application of quantum computing combined with artificial intelligence in medical imaging, an emerging and interdisciplinary frontier with great potential. We look forward to her innovative contributions and wish her a fruitful and rewarding graduate journey!

欢迎博士新生王奥加入我们课题组！

我们很高兴地宣布，王奥于 2026 年 9 月 1 日正式加入我们课题组，成为一名博士研究生。王奥硕士毕业于重庆大学仪器科学与技术专业，研究方向为 CT 重建算法。我们相信他的加入将进一步推动我们在前沿医学成像技术方面的探索，期待他的贡献，并祝愿他在博士阶段取得丰硕成果！

Welcome PhD Student Ao Wang to Our Team!

We are delighted to announce that Ao Wang has officially joined our group as a PhD student on September 1st, 2026. Ao received his master’s degree in Instrument Science and Technology from Chongqing University, and his research will focus on CT reconstruction algorithms. We believe his expertise will further strengthen our efforts in advancing cutting-edge medical imaging technologies. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!

恭喜国自然青C项目顺利获批！

恭喜余海军博士负责的国自然青C项目顺利获批！项目名称为“螺旋阳极线源双环静态CT成像研究”！

Congratulations on the successful approval of the NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category C) Project!

Congratulations to Dr. Yu Haijun on the successful approval of the NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category C) project led by him! The project is titled “Research on Spiral Anode Linear Source Dual-Ring Static CT Imaging.”

恭喜国自然面上项目顺利获批！

恭喜黄益星老师负责的国自然面上项目顺利获批！项目名称为“比特受限环境下的高分辨率高精度CT图像量子重建”！

Congratulations on the successful NSFC General Program grant!

Congratulations to Professor Huang Yixing on securing the NSFC General Program grant! The project, titled “Quantum Reconstruction of High-Resolution and High-Precision CT Images in Bit-Constrained Environments,” has been officially approved.

北京大学工学院2026年开学典礼暨军训开训仪式举行

黄益星老师受邀参加北京大学工学院2026年开学典礼暨军训开训仪式。黄老师作为工学院校友代表发言，回顾自己作为生物医学工程专业首届本科生，在校时期精致化小班教学、交叉课程体系、本研导师指导、暑期海外交流等培养经历，感恩学院对学生的细致栽培。他结合自己的亲身经历，为新生分享关于学业规划的建议。

The College of Engineering at Peking University held its 2026 Opening Ceremony and Military Training Kick-off Ceremony

Dr. Huang Yixing was invited to attend the ceremony and delivered a speech as an alumnus representative of the College of Engineering. In his remarks, he reflected on his time as a member of the inaugural undergraduate cohort in Biomedical Engineering, recalling formative experiences such as small-class intensive teaching, an interdisciplinary curriculum, mentorship in undergraduate research, and summer overseas exchange programs. He expressed his gratitude to the School for its meticulous cultivation of students. Drawing on his personal journey, he also shared practical advice with the incoming students on planning their academic paths.

北京市自然科学基金联合基金培育项目顺利获批！

非常感谢北京市自然科学基金委和北京朗视仪器股份有限公司的大力支持！也非常感谢余海军和刘雨洁两位组员在项目申请中做出的重要贡献！

The cultivation project of the Beijing Natural Science Foundation Joint Fund has been successfully approved!

Many thanks to the Beijing Natural Science Foundation Committee and Beijing Langshi Instrument Co., Ltd. for their strong support! I would also like to express my sincere gratitude to our team members Yu Haijun and Liu Yujie for their significant contributions to the project application.

扩散生成模型用于CT视野扩增的工作顺利发表在IEEE TRPMS

Our manuscript on the study of efficient diffusion generative models for computed tomography field-of-view (FOV) extension has been successfully accepted by IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences . [Manuscript]

2026年北京大学医学部医学技术研究院师生德国访问顺利结束!

 

 

Our graph-guided 3D Gaussian framework, featuring denoised initialization and pixel-graph-aware densification to suppress sparse-view artifacts in cone-beam CT reconstruction, has been successfully published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging.

黄益星老师负责的《高级医学人工智能》研究生课程成功获得2025年北京大学研究生课程建设资助立项！课程资助额度为每门课2万元。2025年秋季，《高级医学人工智能》课程首次开课即吸引了来自北大医学部各院系及附属医院的178名学生选修，规模远超预期，课程质量获得师生高度评价。在此特别感谢每位授课教师的大力支持！

The graduate course “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence,” led by Professor Huang Yixing, has successfully received funding from Peking University’s 2025 Graduate Course Development Initiative! The funding amount for each course is 20,000 RMB. In the fall of 2025, the “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence” course attracted 178 students from various departments and affiliated hospitals of Peking University Health Science Center in its first offering, far exceeding expectations. The course quality has been highly praised by both faculty and students. Special thanks to every lecturers for their tremendous support!

 

祝贺钟祚栋同学荣获 2025 年度宝钢优秀学生奖！宝钢教育奖由宝钢于 1990 年出资设立，由教育部主管，是全国最具知名度的教育奖项之一，覆盖全国 31 个省区 120 余所高校，每年在全国范围内评选约 500 名优秀学生。在北京科技大学，该奖项面向全校所有专业、所有年级评选，每年仅有 2 名本科生获奖，是学校最具分量的本科生荣誉之一。钟祚栋是北京科技大学自动化学院自动化专业的大四本科生，即将加入本课题组开展研究生阶段的学习。学校官方微信公众号已对此进行报道：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/BIi0fDSpUGNLGTRJJCXMlg。我们向钟祚栋同学取得的优异成绩表示热烈祝贺，并期待他加入课题组后取得更加出色的研究成果。


Congratulations to Zuodong Zhong on receiving the 2025 Baosteel Outstanding Student Award! Established in 1990 by Baosteel and administered under China’s Ministry of Education, the Baosteel Education Award is one of the most prestigious nationwide education honors in China, covering more than 120 universities across 31 provinces and recognizing roughly 500 outstanding students nationwide each year. At the University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB), the award is selected university-wide across all majors and grade levels, with only two undergraduate recipients granted annually — making it one of USTB’s most competitive student honors. Zuodong is a senior undergraduate majoring in Automation at USTB’s School of Automation and Electrical Engineering, and will join our group for his graduate studies. The award has been officially featured by USTB’s WeChat public account: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/BIi0fDSpUGNLGTRJJCXMlg. We warmly congratulate Zuodong on this remarkable recognition and look forward to welcoming him to the lab.

Congratulations to Hongrun Dong on completing his master’s thesis and starting a new position at United Imaging Healthcare as a Clinical Application Specialist (CAS). His M.Sc. thesis is entitled “Deep Learning for Cone-Beam CT Field-of-View Extension.” The thesis was supervised by Yixing Huang, together with Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. This work focuses on projection-domain completion for truncated CBCT projections to improve downstream reconstruction quality. Best wishes to Hongrun for a great start and continued success in his new role.

祝贺董洪润顺利完成硕士毕业论文并入职联影医疗（United Imaging Healthcare），担任临床应用专家（CAS）。其硕士论文题为《Deep Learning for Cone-Beam CT Field-of-View Extension》，由黄益星老师指导（并与 Florian Putz、Andreas Maier 共同指导）。论文围绕锥束CT（CBCT）投影截断导致的视野受限问题，研究投影域补全与外延（projection completion/outpainting）以提升后续重建质量。祝董洪润在新岗位工作顺利、持续成长。

欢迎李萌博士加入团队

我们欢迎李萌博士于2026年4月1日加入我们课题组担任博士后研究员。李博士致力于应用基于多模态磁共振成像（MRI）的方法评估脑部疾病并识别与神经精神障碍相关的潜在生物标志物。她的研究将进一步推动我们在医学图像分析方面的探索

Welcome Dr. Meng Li to Our Team!

We are delighted to welcome Dr. Meng Li to join our research group as a postdoctoral researcher on April 1st, 2025. Dr. Li focus on establishing multimodal MRI-based methodologies to assess brain diseases and identify potential biomarkers associated with neuropsychiatric disorders, and her research will further promote our exploration in the field of medical image analysis.

祝贺王安琪的硕士论文研究成功发表于德国医学影像会议（BVM）论文集。她的摘要题为《脑转移瘤自动分割深度学习模型的比较研究》。王安琪是德国埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学医学技术硕士生。她的论文由黄益星、Florian Putz和Andreas Maier共同指导。她目前在汉诺威医学院诊断与介入放射学研究所iMRI课题组攻读博士学位。祝愿安琪的博士生涯一切顺利。

Congratulations to Anqi Wang’s master’s thesis study has been successully published in the German Medical Imaging Conference (BVM) proceeding. Her abstract is entitled Comparative Study of Deep Learning Models for Brain Metastases Autosegmentation. Anqi was a master student of Medical Technology, Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nuremberg, Germany. Her thesis was jointly supervised by Yixing Huang, Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. Now she is a PhD candidate in the iMRI group, Institute for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, Hannover Medical School. Best wishes to Anqi’s PhD life.

2026年首都卫生发展科研专项青年重点公关项目顺利获批！

热烈祝贺与北京大学肿瘤医院/北京市肿瘤防治研究所季鑫主任联合申请的2026年首都卫生发展科研专项青年重点公关项目顺利获批！项目名称：基于ctDNA与病理智能化多模态数据融合的胃癌疾病监测智能体构建与应用的临床研究。

Warm congratulations on the successful approval of the 2026 Capital Health Development Research Special Youth Key Project, jointly applied with Director Ji Xin from Peking University Cancer Hospital/Beijing Institute for Cancer Prevention and Treatment! Project Title: Clinical Study on the Construction and Application of an Intelligent Agent for Gastric Cancer Disease Monitoring
Based on ctDNA and Pathological Intelligent Multimodal Data Fusion.

公示

恭喜余海军博士顺利获得北京大学医学部博雅博士后！

Congratulations to Dr. Haijun Yu on successfully obtaining the Boya Postdoctoral Fellowship at Peking University Health Science Center!

 

Welcome Master Student Shuangyang Zhong!

We are pleased to welcome Shuangyang Zhong, who has officially joined our group as a master’s student on September 1st, 2025. He previously completed his bachelor’s degree as part of the very first cohort of our Medical Technology program. His current research will focus on MRI diffusion image analysis, an important area in medical imaging and brain research. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his graduate studies!

 

 

欢迎余海军博士加入团队

我们很高兴地宣布，余海军博士于2025年8月1日加入我们课题组担任博士后研究员。余博士在CT重建领域拥有深厚的专业背景，他的研究将进一步推动我们在前沿成像技术方面的探索。

Welcome Dr. Haijun Yu to Our Team!

About Lab

The Artificial Intelligence for Medical Imaging (AIMI) Lab at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, has been newly established. The lab is dedicated to advancing both fundamental research and clinical translation of artificial intelligence in medical imaging, with a strong focus on precision medicine. Its research areas include CT image reconstruction, MRI-based tumor segmentation, image-guided radiation oncology, patient prognosis and survival analysis, digital pathology, and computer-vision-driven medical image generation. AIMI strives to develop cutting-edge intelligent imaging technologies to support disease diagnosis, treatment planning, and therapy assessment.

北京大学医学部医学技术研究院智能医学影像实验室（Artificial Intelligence for Medical Imaging, AIMI）近日正式成立。课题组聚焦人工智能在医学影像领域的基础研究与临床转化应用，面向精准医学的发展需求，重点开展 CT 图像重建、MRI 肿瘤自动分割、图像引导肿瘤放疗、患者预后与生存分析、数字病理、机器视觉驱动的医学图像生成等方向的研究。实验室致力于推进智能影像技术的发展，为疾病诊断、治疗决策与疗效评估提供创新性的技术支撑。
